title: Climate control operation and rear passenger controls
summary: Feedback on climate control centers on basic operation, settings access, and whether rear passengers have their own controls, with many excerpts being descriptive rather than clearly evaluative.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise climate control performance or say it works well, though the examples are limited.

negative.summary: Negative reviews complain about a cluttered climate-control screen and the lack of rear passenger climate controls or rear display features.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mostly mention climate-control settings, modes, remote start, preconditioning, or customer inquiries without a clear positive or negative judgment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear evaluative evidence is limited.
The positive sample is sparse and one cited positive-assigned fragment includes conflicting wording, limiting confidence in specific praise details.
Some excerpts are service-writer or customer inquiry notes rather than full consumer opinions, which limits interpretability.
